patch_description: The prior best program (score 0.67) used a soft objective (mean of the k smallest triangle areas) in the polish phase, which escapes flat minima where the true minimum cannot be improved by single coordinate moves. The current program regressed to a hard-min polish (0.58). This edit restores the soft-score polish, and additionally augments the annealing inner loop with an axis-wise directional fallback: when a Gaussian 2-D move is rejected, try the four axis-aligned perturbations (±x, ±y) before rejecting — as recommended. This exploits cheap vectorized rescoring and broadens the search within the time budget. To keep runtime in the ~4s sweet spot, annealing iterations are trimmed slightly (2000 + 600 reheat).
